findings.summary: When verifyCodeChange fails for one comment, the batch reset incorrectly leaves the attempt records of other batch members in a non-failed state and returns them with action 'fixed', violating the plan's requirement to mark every batch member failed on code-verifier failure.
findings.suggested_fix: In executeBatch under if (verifierErrors.size > 0), remove the if (verifierErrors.has(a.commentId)) check when setting a.completedHead/disposition/action/repo.update, and unconditionally map action to 'failed' in the returned outputs, ensuring only the verifierFeedback uses the check.
